ambiguities.source_text: Find the time between when a vehicle is first advertised on the site to when the vehicle was sold
ambiguities.intent: Parse publish_ts using DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS; parse the supplied sale_date using day, English full month name, year, at midnight. Compute elapsed days from these actual timestamps.

ambiguities.source_text: Find the time between when a vehicle is first advertised on the site to when the vehicle was sold

ambiguities.source_text: group up to the nearest whole day
ambiguities.ref: Dealership Avg Days = ceil(avg(Days to Sell))
ambiguities.intent: For each dealership, take the mean of the already ceiled per-record Days to Sell and then apply ceiling again. This is upward rounding, not nearest-integer rounding.

ambiguities.source_text: Find the time between when a vehicle is first advertised on the site to when the vehicle was sold
ambiguities.ref:
delta_days = (ads["sale_date_dt"] - ads["first_publish"]
                  ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
ads["Days to Sell"] = delta_days.apply(
        lambda x: math.ceil(x) if pd.notna(x) else pd.NA)
ambiguities.intent: For each retained first-posted sold ad, Days to Sell is the ceiling of elapsed seconds from publish timestamp to sale-date midnight divided by 86400.
